description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the LogicalSearchFilter interface, specifically the ImmutableLogicalFilter class, which supports logical operations such as NOT, AND, and OR for search filters within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ImmutableLogicalFilter
classes.description: An immutable class implementing logical search filter combinators (NOT, AND, OR), providing a thread-safe way to construct complex logical filters.

methods.name: not
methods.description: Creates a logical NOT filter wrapping the provided SearchFilter.

methods.name: and
methods.description: Creates a logical AND filter combining multiple SearchFilter instances.

methods.name: or
methods.description: Creates a logical OR filter combining multiple SearchFilter instances.
